queries:
SELECT
  observstation,
  COUNT(*) AS telescope_count,
  1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
FROM telescopes
GROUP BY observstation
ORDER BY telescope_count DESC, observstation
LIMIT 10

SELECT
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count,
    100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS telescope_percentage
FROM telescopes
GROUP BY observstation
ORDER BY telescope_count DESC, observstation
LIMIT 10

WITH station_counts AS (
    SELECT o.observstation,
           COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
    FROM observatories AS o
    LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
      ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    GROUP BY o.observstation
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT observstation,
           telescope_count,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY telescope_count DESC) AS station_rank,
           telescope_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS telescope_share
    FROM station_counts
)
SELECT observstation, telescope_count, station_rank, telescope_share
FROM ranked
ORDER BY station_rank, observstation
LIMIT 10

WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatories AS o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
)
SELECT
  observstation,
  telescope_count,
  100.0 * telescope_count / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS telescope_share_pct,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY telescope_count DESC) AS station_rank
FROM station_counts
ORDER BY station_rank, observstation
LIMIT 10

WITH station_counts AS (
    SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
    FROM telescopes
    GROUP BY observstation
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        observstation,
        telescope_count,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY telescope_count DESC) AS station_rank
    FROM station_counts
)
SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    telescope_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS telescope_share
FROM ranked
WHERE station_rank <= 10
ORDER BY telescope_count DESC, observstation
